failed_attempt_1.evidence: failed-attempt1-guards/ (journal.jsonl, stage logs, phase telemetry, driver.log)
failed_attempt_1.failure: sft-1e4-exposure exited 0 and published its endpoint, then the driver's immediate post-exit check saw an owned descendant still live (stop_reason stage_exited_with_owned_descendants) and ended the envelope. The survivor's identity was not recorded. No process remained when inspected minutes later.
failed_attempt_1.endpoint_disposition: The published sft-1e4-exposure endpoint is retained: its trainer receipt was written by a stage that exited 0 before the check ran. Disclosed as produced inside a failed envelope.

change: Survivor check waits up to 30 s for owned descendants to exit, journals any survivors with pid and cmdline, and only then fails. Driver verifies this addendum and addendum-1. No science, limit or stage-order change. Already-published stages are skipped. The new 43200 s envelope starts at driver start.
host_load_disclosure: During attempt 1 the Harbor SFT resource probe ran in the Colima VM (2 container CPUs) concurrently with sft-5e5/sft-1e4 exposure stages; other sessions kept host load average around 30+. Active-time comparisons carry this uncontrolled contention.
